milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target object and face it, modeling 'player can see the chiseled sandstone'. The target is the chiseled sandstone pillar at spawn-relative [8, 1, 8]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the block.
